get.description:
Default sort on `status` (NEW,IN_PROGRESS,DONE) and `lastModificationDate` (reversed). It's possible to override it by sorting on other attributes.
If order is no provided when sort, the default is asc.
It's possible to filter on one or more criticalities or statuses.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number requested, triggers an error if not specified or if 0.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size, returns an empty list if not specified.

parameters.name: creationDate
parameters.description: The date must be set to midnight. The filter will return all events created on that day.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: The equipment entity name. It must be known to the system.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: The equipment family code. It must be known to the system.

200.description: Return 2 events with `status` is `DONE` or `NEW` and `criticality` is `LOW` or `HIGH`
